sentences: A plane directed graph comes with an embedding that constrains how its edges are arranged.
The saved question asks for polylogarithmic query time for a dynamic all-pairs problem in such graphs.
Preprocessing and updates must retain enough global pairwise information to answer without a costly new search.
Exploiting the embedding could make a difficult directed query problem more manageable.
